sources.snippet: It is produced by merging the Macaron-V1-Venti L2 Coding LoRA specialist into the GLM-5.2 BF16 base model, yielding a single merged checkpoint for coding, terminal, repository, and software-engineering workflows.

sources.title: Introducing Macaron-V1
sources.snippet: Macaron-V1 is Mind Lab's agent model in 748B Venti and 35B Tall variants, built on Mixture-of-LoRA and model-harness co-design.

sources.snippet: Macaron-V1-Coding-Venti — MindLab's coding-specialist checkpoint: the Macaron-V1-Venti L2 Coding LoRA merged into the GLM-5.2 BF16 base. Same MoE architecture and launch as GLM-5.2 (~743B total, 39B active), no runtime adapter.
